caption:
What Musa said when heading into the unknown

As Musa headed towards Midian, he said that his Lord would surely guide him to a straight way. Trust in Allah can come before the road is clear.

Surah Al-Qasas 28:22

Facing a new start this week? Say these words before you take the first step.

#trustinallah #prophetmusa #surahqasas #newbeginnings

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
